Privacy notice

A short note on how the 홍대화덕피자 website handles visitor information.

What we do not collect

This website has no fields for entering your name or phone number. Reservations are made on Naver, and the details you enter there are handled under Naver's privacy policy.

Website analytics

Only if you choose 'Allow analytics' in the analytics notice, we use Google Analytics to measure referrals, pages viewed and clicks on Naver and phone links. This uses analytics cookies and device/browser information. Ad personalization is not used.

Declining or withdrawing consent

If you choose 'Decline' on your first visit, nothing is measured. If you allowed it earlier, tap 'Privacy & analytics' at the bottom of the page and choose 'Decline'. Measurement stops and the stored analytics cookies are deleted. You can keep using the website either way.
